stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Checkout shows span-level errors in the window: traces_span_metrics_calls_total increase over 5m is 2.5 for span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR, versus 6.25 STATUS_CODE_UNSET for the same span; checkout's client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge also shows 2.5 STATUS_CODE_ERROR. Checkout's HTTP POST and oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart ERROR series are explicitly 0.

Error spans are concentrated on the payment path: checkout|payment ERROR-status span increases are 2.5 for checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, 2.5 for checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, and 2.5 for payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge; checkout HTTP POST and cart oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart show 0.

Checkout's client-side gRPC counters show failures only toward payment: rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count increase over 5m is 70.0 with rpc_grpc_status_code 0 and 2.5 with code 2 (UNKNOWN); by method, code 2 appears only on oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (2.5), while Charge/Convert/EmptyCart/GetCart/GetProduct/GetQuote/ShipOrder success counts are code 0 (Charge 6.25, Convert 21.25, EmptyCart 6.25, GetCart 8.75, GetProduct 12.5, GetQuote 8.75, ShipOrder 6.25) and one empty code-9 EmptyCart series (0).

Two failing traces are visible. Trace 6ec2b4d9acf06e3621a0e8527e4f263c: payment server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge errored (15.271 ms) with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; checkout client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (span 884bacb5b0a32255) errored with rpc.grpc.status_code 2 and the same description; checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (span 97d69d159ca1e976) errored with rpc.grpc.status_code 13 and 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown'; frontend POST /api/checkout and frontend-proxy ingress carried HTTP 500/ERROR. Trace 3d105579b7d6a87645e7883bdd3fa2eb shows the same pattern (payment Charge error 7.051 ms, checkout client Charge span 5b6c22e17c324bb8 code 2, checkout PlaceOrder span 7a4159469cc92e7d code 13, frontend 500).

Two sampled checkout traces in the window are fully successful with no error status tags: trace bd9619d2fd0d5ce305d4d6ea7d9820f4 (PlaceOrder 61.407 ms, checkout client Charge 8.520 ms, GetQuote 5.544 ms, GetCart 1.025 ms, GetProduct 0.880 ms, Convert 0.910–2.560 ms, email POST /send_order_confirmation 23.139 ms, shipping POST 4.160 ms, frontend HTTP 200) and trace e393457d21e90efb8a07e3d15ac82557 (PlaceOrder 43.349 ms, Charge 5.322 ms, GetQuote 3.473 ms, GetCart 0.951 ms, GetProduct 0.604 ms, email 19.690 ms, HTTP POST 200 at checkout, frontend HTTP 200).

No latency elevation is visible in checkout's client-call histograms for the window: for cart, currency, payment, product-catalog and shipping the cumulative +Inf and le=50 buckets are equal (cart 15.0, currency 21.25, payment 8.75, product-catalog 12.5, shipping 15.0), i.e. every recorded call was at or under 50 ms; only payment has calls above 25 ms (le=25 = 7.5 of 8.75 total, so about 1.25 calls in the 25–50 ms bucket). Payment Charge buckets likewise show le=50 and +Inf both 8.75, with le=10 = 3.75 and le=0/le=5 = 0.

Other dependency error series are explicitly zero or absent: cart POST /oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart ERROR increase 0 and product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct ERROR increase 0; currency spans are only STATUS_CODE_OK (Currency/Convert 21.25), while shipping spans (oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote 8.75, ShipOrder 6.25, POST 8.75) and email spans (POST /send_order_confirmation 6.25, send_email 6.25, sinatra.render_template 12.5) were recorded only with STATUS_CODE_UNSET in this window.

The elevated checkout errors are most consistent with an application-level payment rejection rather than a dependency slowdown: failed Charge spans are short (payment server 15.271 ms and 7.051 ms; checkout client 23.719 ms and 13.263 ms) and carry the explicit message 'Invalid token' with gRPC code 2, and checkout PlaceOrder fails with gRPC 13 before /api/checkout returns 500. This is an inference from a small biased sample, not proof of root cause.

Not all checkout traffic failed and dependency legs looked fast: two traces in the same window completed with every dependency span at gRPC/HTTP success status and checkout PlaceOrder in 43–61 ms, with product-catalog replies of 73–425 µs, cart 0.2–6.8 ms, shipping 2.5–9.4 ms, currency 0.3–1.8 ms and email ~16–23 ms.

Rejected as the failing dependency in this window: cart and product-catalog. Their ERROR-status span series are explicitly 0 (cart oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct), and every sampled cart/product-catalog span carried gRPC status 0 or no status. This does not clear currency, shipping or email, whose error series were not returned.

Human follow-up should inspect payment's invalid-token/charge path (charge.js and the loyalty-level token values used by the load generator) and check whether the ~2.5 failed Charge spans in 5 minutes represent a deliberate fault-injection or a real credential/config regression, since no baseline or complete request count is available to size the error rate.

gaps: No latency baseline (earlier window) was queried, and latency metrics were only available as cumulative histogram buckets; therefore 'elevated latency' cannot be confirmed or refuted, only bounded (all checkout client calls ≤50 ms in this window).
A trace search for checkout over 08:32:11–08:33:11 returned status no_data (0 traces, 0 spans), so the state of checkout in the most recent minute before the window end is unknown.

Both successful trace searches were truncated samples (limit reached, incomplete=true: 2 traces each), so trace span counts are not request counts and no complete call chain or failure rate can be derived; any checkout error traces beyond the two cited traces are unknown.
No ERROR-status series was returned for currency, shipping or email span metrics in the sampled query; absence means their error status is unknown, not zero (their visible spans were OK/UNSET only).

Checkout's own HTTP POST ERROR series is 0 while frontend /api/checkout returned HTTP 500 in the sampled error traces; the exact mapping between checkout HTTP span status and request outcome is unresolved.
The 5-minute increase values are fractional (e.g. 2.5, 6.25), so the absolute failed-request count in the window is unknown; only relative span-status composition is observable.
No policy/instrumentation timing for trace ingestion lag was supplied, so the delay between 08:32:11 and 08:33:11 producing no traces is unexplained.
next_steps: Compare the same span-status and checkout client RPC latency metrics against an earlier baseline window (e.g. the preceding hour) to determine whether error counts and latencies are genuinely elevated.
Ask a human to inspect payment's charge handler and the token/loyalty-level input used in this environment for the 'Invalid token' rejection, and confirm whether fault injection is enabled.
Re-run a narrow checkout/payment trace search around the very end of the window at a later time to close the no_data gap for the most recent minute.
